none: PAS NLM-C26A52: Roman Coin: Commemorative Nummus for Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, Posthumous commemorative issue of 337-340 for Constantine I (306-337), Reece period 17. Obverse description: Veiled head right. Obverse inscription: [DIV CONSTANTINVS PT AVGG]. Reverse description: Emperor ascending in quadriga right. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.4mm, Weight: 1.56gms, die axis: 6
